title: chart.json — the EAR Country Chart, five destinations
description: Supplement No. 1 to 15 CFR 738, content date 2026-09-01. A country row has SEVENTEEN <TD> children in the source XML: cell[0] is the country name and cells[1..16] are the sixteen control columns. Empty cells are meaningful and must be preserved. Footnotes are <sup> elements, not glued digits.

column_headers.description: CB 1 · CB 2 · CB 3 · NP 1 · NP 2 · NS 1 · NS 2 · MT 1 · RS 1 · RS 2 · FC 1 · CC 1 · CC 2 · CC 3 · AT 1 · AT 2
